role: GameProfile serialization: reads a player's name, id and properties from the Owner compound of a player skull and writes them back.
scope_reason: Player-skull owner profiles come only from commands or creative (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: func_152459_a
members.note: Reads Name and Id and, for a null id, looks the name up online; no native counterpart and the native skull layer stores only the skull type.

members.name: func_152460_a
members.note: Writes the profile back including the Properties compound; no native counterpart.

missing: The GameProfile Owner compound for player skulls (TileEntitySkull and BlockSkull placement write it, ItemSkull and the renderers read it): no native counterpart, and no recording exercises a player skull.
notes: The only in-game callers are the skull tile entity, BlockSkull's placement and the skull item and renderer paths (verified by grep). A skeleton or wither-skeleton skull never carries an Owner, so the recorded gates do not reach this code; the charged-creeper route is the one way it becomes reachable.
